name: NSW Low Income Household Rebate
summary: Daily credit on your electricity bill for NSW households holding a Health Care Card or other eligible concession card.
who: Hold a Pensioner Concession Card, Health Care Card, Low Income Health Care Card or DVA Veteran Gold Card
how: Contact your electricity retailer and ask for the rebate to be applied
Give your concession card details and confirm it has been applied
catches: The page does not state the dollar amount. Embedded network (on-supply) customers apply through Service NSW instead.

source.label: Service NSW: Apply for the Low Income Household Rebate (retail customers)

evidence.quote: Health Care Card issued by Services Australia
Retail customers receive the rebate as a daily credit on each electricity bill.
